name: geoaiworkbench
description: Controlled empirical comparison of three paradigms for LLM-driven GIS automation
//workspaces: Members are the Python packages, the agent-tooling façades, and the documentation site. `python` itself is listed explicitly as well as globbed: `python/*` matches `python/geoai-core` and its siblings but NOT `python/package.json`, and the container package is the one whose `turbo.json` turns caching off for all three. Without the explicit entry the nested config is silently dead. `docs` is the Astro + Starlight site; it is a plain member rather than a glob because there is exactly one of it, and it is the only package whose `build` produces an output turbo can cache (`docs/turbo.json`). There is no TypeScript source outside it yet, so nothing needs a `typecheck`; turbo skips a task a package does not declare, and the seam is where the first TS package lands. `opencode-ai` is deliberately NOT a dependency: it is a CLI installed globally by `pixi run opencode-install`, and a copy in node_modules is a second version nobody would run.
